hypothesis: Fixed actor features may discard finger-position precision needed to express current-relative successful labels. Adding the exact observed coordinate to readout residual features tests whether that omission is a sufficient explanation, before any new architecture or robot query.
inputs: Same384teacher/1024rehearsal rows and held-out source episodes from original readout audit; no new data or split selection
control: Original frozen-feature readout, original source actor raw means, rho4/ridge.001 sum8-perrow objective
intervention: Append exact (q7-.015)/.025 to residual fit features only; sametargets, rowcounts, originalrawreference andregularization. Diagnostic extra feature, not safe exportedpolicy.
gate: In BOTHparents held-out finger-targetRMSE<1mm and<half original; old executed-actionRMSchange<=original. This tests sufficiency of coordinate availability, not generalized learning.
falsification: If exactfeature fails, reject missing-finger-coordinate-alone as sufficient underthisfixedobjective; do not launch another robotdistiller. If passes, onlyjustify representational implementation/review, noautomaticGPU.
limitations: Adaptively reused held-out diagnostic corpus; source actors/dataset acquired previously, not fromscratch. Onefeaturechangeslinearfunctionclass; nolearningefficiencyclaim.
